replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
In order to make a sequel of an already existing map, you must be authorized by the author, who in this case is ParaPenguin/Haribo98.

Anyways, about the map...
It seems plain, except for the pyramid. It's just trees scattered almost everywhere and a small building.
Is there an underground section? or more buildings? If not, you should add some!
Everything just seems too random to me, try adding more things to your map. Thanks!
I wish you good luck with it :)
